faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.description: Everything you need to know about {{appName}}.

q1.question: What is FormCraft?
q1.answer: FormCraft is a modern low-code platform that enables you to build dynamic forms using drag-and-drop, conditional logic, analytics, and multilingual support.

q2.question: Do I need coding experience?
q2.answer: No. FormCraft is designed so anyone can create professional forms without writing code.

q3.question: Can I share my forms publicly?
q3.answer: Yes. You can publish forms and securely share them using unique public links.

q4.question: Does FormCraft support multiple languages?
q4.answer: Yes. Multilingual support is part of the platform roadmap and will allow forms to be used in different languages.

q5.question: Can I export responses?
q5.answer: Yes. FormCraft supports exporting responses and provides analytics to help you understand collected data.
